answer.diagnosis: Many layer-1 units have unusually large weights (magnitude about 50-99) on a small 3x3 patch at image rows 1-3, columns 1-3 in the top-left corner. This patch is far from the central blob. The positive-patch units (1, 3, 7, 8, 13, 18, 20, 24, 27, 28) also carry positive ring or disk templates over the blob region. The negative-patch units (11, 12, 16, 17, 19, 21, 25, 26, 29, 31) carry the opposite blob templates. So brightness in that corner pushes the logit the same way as a large blob does, which looks like a corner-marker shortcut that was correlated with the label. Units with no blob template (0, 2, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 14, 15, 22, 23, 30) show only small noise-level weights there. The fix zeroes the corner patch weights in every layer-1 unit. The blob-size templates in the centre are left untouched.
